correctness.rationale: The critical source lemmas are now read in full. Proposition 2.3 supplies L distinct indecomposable syzygy summands with the full L self-Ext vanishing inherited at each term. A further indecomposable nonprojective summand X_L exists because X_{L-1} is nonprojective in perpendicular A; if X_L repeated any X_i, dimension shifting within L degrees would make its stable identity zero. Distinct B-projective X_i=Be_a have distinct left vertices and their semisimple syzygy successors X_{i+1} have distinct nonprojective simple right vertices, including i=L-1, yielding a matching of size p and p<=nu. The retained R>=L-nu=kappa+rho+1 terms transfer their backward Ext and Hom vanishing by Zhang–Zhou Lemma 3.1, Proposition 3.3 injection (3.2), and Corollary 3.7. Isolated H vertices are projective simple factors and cannot occur in indecomposable nonprojective F(X); Lemma 3.8 then bounds R<=kappa+rho. Companion delta count uses precisely the source Proposition 4.3's eventual J²-annihilation argument.
